about: Tinnitus V2 (docs/gameplay/tinnitus_v2_plan.md 3). Loud events add to a player's hearing load; the load sets the tinnitus stage (light / tinnitus / severe), during which ringing comes now and then and the world's sounds are quieter. A shot's dose is 10^((ear_db - reference_db) / 10) at the shooter's ear (ear_db in each gun's noise block), over the distance squared for others, x indoor without sky overhead; a blast's (explosions, lightning) blast x (radius / blast_radius)^2 / max(1, distance)^2. Worn hearing protection and the tinnitus attribute multiply every dose. The load halves every half_life_ticks (asleep x sleep).
